_comment: Template for adapters/claude-code-hooks/config.json. Copy to config.json and fill in real paths for a specific project. Primary classification is ../protected_write_classifier.py (shared with adapters/codex-hooks/), which matches a tool call's target path against protected_paths below, regardless of the calling tool's identity. 'mappings' is an optional, more-precise override for a confirmed tool_name; leave it empty if none is confirmed -- an unconfirmed placeholder tool_name is worse than no mapping, since it can never match and just looks like coverage that isn't there.

mappings._comment: Example only -- only add an entry here once a project has actually confirmed this is the real tool_name its host reports for this capability.
